title: Plugin Store Document
description: What the marketplace shows about a plugin apart from its runtime manifest: names, descriptions, homepage and screenshots. It lives where the store field of the plugin's entry says, as plugin.store.json in the plugin repository or as store/<id>/store.json here, and nothing generates it. Names in it are proposals that go through the same review as the names of a manifest. The developer portal writes it.

name.description: Proposed names by language, at most 64 characters each. They are reviewed before they are listed.

description.description: At most 1000 characters in each language.

screenshots.description: Images of the plugin in use, in display order. PNG, JPEG or WebP, about 16:10 at 1280 to 1920 pixels wide.

imagePath.description: A path relative to the root of the plugin repository, or media:<sha256> for an image uploaded through the developer portal.

id.description: Stays the same while the image changes, so captions and translations follow it.

dark_path.description: The same view in the dark theme, at the size of path. Hosts show path when it is absent.
